candidate_requirements.requirement: Obtain and review the full operative and medication record (agents, doses, timing of lidocaine/phenylephrine and intracameral exposure) to assess iatrogenic/drug-related and procedure-related causes
candidate_requirements.rationale: Profound postoperative visual loss with RAPD immediately after IOL exchange demands cause-focused review of what was actually given and done; the record is stated to be available
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Direct verbal report from surgical/anaesthesia team; documented medication administration chart
candidate_requirements.deadline: immediately, before further assessment priorities are finalised in this written plan

candidate_requirements.requirement: Urgent neuroimaging result (already ordered) must be actively followed up, plus assessment for retrobulbar/optic nerve and cortical causes given the RAPD and supraorbital headache
candidate_requirements.rationale: No light perception with a marked RAPD but an attached perfused retina localises the lesion posterior to the retina; neuroimaging is ordered but no result is available, so its status is a missing item at the decision point
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Escalation to neuro-ophthalmology or stroke/neurology service if imaging access is delayed
candidate_requirements.deadline: within the urgent window of this encounter, as the first follow-up priority

candidate_requirements.requirement: Repeat focused ocular assessment (IOP trend, gonioscopy/retinal periphery for occult pathology, optic nerve and vascular perfusion testing) to clarify what the preserved retinal appearance does not exclude
candidate_requirements.rationale: A single reassuring dilated view does not exclude early choroidal haemorrhage, vascular occlusion or optic nerve dysfunction; repeat examination adds discriminating value
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Documented plan for urgent fluorescein angiography or OCT once feasible, without inventing results
candidate_requirements.deadline: at the proposed next assessment step in this written plan
